title: Resource Usage
content: Build resource usage dashboard. CPU: usage percentage with gauge. Memory: used/total with bar. Storage: disk usage breakdown. Network: bandwidth usage. Processes: top resource-consuming processes. Alerts: threshold warning indicators. History: usage over time charts. Comparison: compare to capacity limits.

variants.detailed: Build resource usage dashboard. CPU: usage percentage with gauge. Memory: used/total with bar. Storage: disk usage breakdown. Network: bandwidth usage. Processes: top resource-consuming processes. Alerts: threshold warning indicators. History: usage over time charts. Comparison: compare to capacity limits.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive resource usage dashboard for infrastructure monitoring. Metric gauges: circular or semi-circular gauges for CPU %, Memory %, Disk %, each with value label, color zones (green <70%, yellow 70-90%, red >90%). Gauge details: show used/total (8 GB / 16 GB), percentage prominently displayed. Memory breakdown: used, cached, available, swap, stacked bar or breakdown chart. CPU breakdown: by core if multi-core, user vs system vs idle, load averages (1m, 5m, 15m). Disk/storage: per-volume breakdown, used/total/available, inode usage if relevant, growth rate projection. Network: inbound/outbound bandwidth, packets/second, current active connections, interface breakdown. Process table: top 10 processes by CPU or memory, columns: PID, name, CPU %, memory %, user, sortable. Historical charts: line charts showing metric over time, selectable time range (1h, 6h, 24h, 7d), zoom and pan. Alerts: visual indicator when threshold exceeded, configurable thresholds, active alerts panel. Capacity planning: current vs capacity limit, projection when capacity reached, recommendation prompts. Comparison: compare to previous period, compare to other servers in cluster. Auto-refresh: real-time updates every 5-10 seconds, last updated timestamp. Server selection: for multiple servers, dropdown to select which to view, or overview dashboard. Export: download usage data, generate capacity report. Responsive: dashboard adapts to different screen sizes. Tooltips: detailed info on hover for each metric.
